page_title: EIN 1-1 WER | Eintracht Frankfurt v Werder Bremen 05/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
90+7' Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance.
90+6' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+6' Timothy Chandler (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt manage to earn a corner.
90+3' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Leonardo Bittencourt is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Christian Gross (Werder Bremen).
89' The substitution has been made. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) has replaced Felix Agu.
89' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) has to leave the pitch!
88' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt)! Let's see what he decides.
87' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) sees a yellow card in the hand of Robert Hartmann. And as it's a second one this game, a red follows and Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is sent from the pitch.
84' Substitution. Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Fares Chaibi walks off.
84' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Ansgar Knauff will be replaced by Timothy Chandler (Eintracht Frankfurt).
83' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Robert Hartmann didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
81' Here comes a substitution. Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Marvin Ducksch.
80' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) goes into the referee's book for dissent.

77' 1 - 1 Willian Pacho produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:1.
74' The attendance for today's match is 55000.
73' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Robert Hartmann had no choice but to send Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) off. VAR seen to good effect there!

73' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
72' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.
71' A snap shot by Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Kevin Trapp produces a good save to thwart him.
70' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
70' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) will deliver the corner kick.
70' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
69' Robert Hartmann shows the yellow card to Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) for a heavy challenge.
65' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Nnamdi Collins.
65' Substitution. Philipp Max is replaced by Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt).
65' Referee Robert Hartmann points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) goes wild in celebration.
63' The Werder Bremen players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Hartmann makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
62' 0 - 1 Goal! Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.
61' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle. Jean Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul after dangerous play. Werder Bremen are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

58' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
57' That's the end of the game for Junior Dina Ebimbe, who is replaced by Jean Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
56' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
56' Referee Robert Hartmann makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Werder Bremen. Let’s see what happens!
56' Surely that's handball by one of the Eintracht Frankfurt players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
55' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) produces a shot from a mid-range free kick. His effort is directed under the crossbar but is caught by the goalkeeper.
53' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Hartmann saw the whole situation. A free kick to Werder Bremen.
53' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is penalised for a foul. Robert Hartmann had a clear view and blows his whistle.
51' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) replaces Amos Pieper.
50' The game is interrupted now, Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
49' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

49' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went well wide of the right post.
48' Rough tackle by Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Eintracht Frankfurt.
47' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) and Romano Schmid try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' A pass lands at the feet of Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Today's referee Robert Hartmann rightly decides to book Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his harsh tackle.

44' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
44' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

42' A fine pass finds Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Michael Zetterer reacts superbly to deny him.
41' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
40' A pass by Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
36' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
36' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Hartmann interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick is awarded to Eintracht Frankfurt.
34' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

34' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.

32' Unbelievable miss! Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
31' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) meets a cross inside the box, but Michael Zetterer wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.

28' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
28' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

28' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner.
27' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Kevin Trapp makes a comfortable save.

25' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp pulls off a comfortable save.
23' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
22' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' The linesman signals that Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
19' Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

18' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Michael Zetterer thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
17' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Hartmann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

13' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
12' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.

11' PENALTY APPEAL after Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
10' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robert Hartmann blows for a foul.
9' A cross is whipped into the box by Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) and Marco Friedl controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
6' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
4' An attempted cross from Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared.
3' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
2' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Robert Hartmann.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
